analysis_status: Post-hoc exploratory diagnostics; original V1 aggregate results were already observed
scope_definition: Within-date full forecast-cohort average ranks split at (n+1)/2; ties remain together in the lower group. Groups are cross-sectional conditions, not market regimes.
partial_rank_definition: On the common observed-label cohort, average-tie-rank scores, outcomes and controls. SVD-project both score and outcome ranks on intercept plus control ranks. Correlate residuals; degenerate residuals are undefined, not zero.
primary_diagnostic: Mean paired daily HGB7 minus reversal5 observed-case Spearman IC
export_policy: Aggregate daily/scoped diagnostics and code/provenance only; raw bars, caches, row-level scores/targets and models remain in the platform
